members.name: banking_routing_v0
members.instructions: A customer wrote this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which specific customer need does the message express? Pick the single option that best matches the main request or problem.

criteria.activate_card: Activating a newly received card or how long activation takes
criteria.card_expiring: Card about to expire or expired; renewing or replacing it because of expiry
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted: which shops, ATMs or merchants take it
criteria.card_arrival: Ordered card has not arrived yet; tracking a card already on its way
criteria.card_delivery_time: How long card delivery takes, delivery date or delivery options before/when ordering
criteria.card_linking: Adding or linking a card to the app, including re-adding a card that was found again after being reported lost
criteria.card_not_working: Physical card not working in general, with no specific detail
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept or swallowed the card
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card purchase/payment was declined or rejected at a shop or online
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: The ATM refused the cash withdrawal; could not take money out of the ATM
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits of disposable virtual cards: how many, how many uses
criteria.get_disposable_card: Getting a disposable / single-use virtual card
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting a physical (plastic) card, and what the bank charges for a card
criteria.order_card: Ordering a new or replacement card
criteria.spare_card: Getting an additional / second / spare card, or cost of extra cards
criteria.get_virtual_card: Getting a virtual card, what a virtual card is
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card (including disposable) not working or being rejected
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Which kinds or brands of card the bank itself issues or offers, whether the customer can choose which card they get, and anything about the Visa or Mastercard brands, including whether Visa / Mastercard cards can be used
criteria.change_pin: Changing or resetting an existing PIN to a different one, or where that can be done
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked after too many wrong attempts, PIN not accepted, or the customer says they have forgotten their PIN
criteria.get_pin: The customer does not know or cannot find the PIN of their card, how the PIN is received, or setting it up for the first time
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs can be used with the card
criteria.top_up_how: How to top up / add money to the account in general
criteria.top_up_by_card: Topping up using a debit or credit card
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or a cheque, where to deposit cash
criteria.top_up_apple_google_pay: Topping up with Apple Pay or Google Pay
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-up amounts, including daily or maximum amount limits on the card or account
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is still pending or has not gone through yet
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed or was declined
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reversed, returned or cancelled after appearing
criteria.verify_top_up: Verification code or verification step for a top-up card
criteria.supported_cards_currencies: Which of the customer's own external cards (credit cards, American Express, foreign cards) or which currencies can be used to add money to the account
criteria.balance_not_updated_transfer: Balance not updated after a bank transfer into the account
criteria.balance_not_updated_cheque_cash: Balance not updated after depositing a cheque or cash
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Unable to send money to a particular recipient / beneficiary not allowed
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wanting to cancel or reverse a transfer already made, e.g. sent to the wrong account
criteria.failed_transfer: An outgoing transfer failed or did not work
criteria.pending_transfer: An outgoing transfer is shown as pending
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money from others, getting salary paid into the account
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to move money from another bank account into this one
criteria.transfer_not_received: Recipient has not received money that was sent
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is still pending / not yet completed
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal still shows as pending
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment was cancelled or reverted / came back
criteria.cash_withdrawal_missing: The customer withdrew cash at an ATM and got the cash, but the withdrawal does not yet show in the balance or transactions
criteria.card_payment_fee: A fee charged for paying with the card, including complaints about new fees on card purchases or payments abroad
criteria.other_fee_question: Whether a fee applies to some other money movement, such as receiving money, and how much it is (not the price of getting or replacing a card)
criteria.card_payment_wrong_rate: Wrong exchange rate applied to a card purchase made in a foreign currency
criteria.cash_withdrawal_fee: A fee charged for ATM cash withdrawals
criteria.cash_withdrawal_wrong_rate: Wrong exchange rate applied to a foreign cash withdrawal
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used and how it is determined
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app
criteria.fiat_currencies: Which fiat currencies can be held or exchanged
criteria.top_up_card_fee: Fee for topping up with a card
criteria.top_up_transfer_fee: Fee for topping up by bank transfer / SEPA
criteria.extra_charge_statement: An extra charge, or a charge of a specific small amount, on the statement that the customer cannot account for and asks to be explained or says was taken in error (a fee on a transaction the customer knows about belongs with the fee options)
criteria.request_refund: Asking for a refund of a purchase, refund policy
criteria.refund_not_showing: A refund has not appeared yet
criteria.charged_twice: The same payment charged twice / duplicate charge
criteria.wrong_cash_amount: ATM gave less cash than requested
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment or unknown charge from a merchant the customer does not recognise, or a payment they did not make
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: The app shows a cash withdrawal, or cash leaving the account, that the customer did not make or never received
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer did not set up or recognise
criteria.compromised_card: Card details compromised, someone else using the card
criteria.unrecognised_incoming_money: Money arrived in the account that the customer did not add and cannot explain
criteria.lost_stolen_card: Card is currently lost or stolen and has not been recovered
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgotten or resetting the app passcode
criteria.verify_identity: How to verify identity, which documents are needed
criteria.unable_verify_identity: Identity verification failing or not possible
criteria.source_of_funds: Verifying or proving the source of funds
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details: name, address, phone number
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account
criteria.country_support: Countries where the service is available
